Digger (2026) | Satirical Disaster Thriller
Directed by Oscar-winner Alejandro G. Iñárritu and starring Tom Cruise, Digger follows powerful billionaire titan Digger Rockwell as a catastrophic, human-triggered glacier shift in Greenland unleashes a string of global disasters. Rather than accepting responsibility or deferring to scientific expertise, Rockwell launches an unhinged, high-stakes corporate campaign to "dig" humanity out of the calamity—attempting to frame his own destructive greed as a grand mission of global salvation.
The film serves as an aggressive, surrealist satire of unchecked ultra-wealth, eco-capitalism, and public relations-driven crisis management. By examining how elite power structures manipulate narrative and commodify global catastrophes, Iñárritu and Cruise deconstruct the modern hero myth, revealing how multi-billion-dollar conglomerates and ego-maniacal oligarchs will burn the planet to ashes just to market themselves as its ultimate savior.
When hyper-capitalist titans cause global destruction under the guise of progress, can humanity ever escape the catastrophic egos of the billionaires claiming to save them? Drop your thoughts below! 👇

source_details.synopsis: Digger is a 2026 American satirical black comedy film co-written, directed, and co-produced by Alejandro González Iñárritu. Tom Cruise, who also produced the film, stars in the role of Digger Rockwell, an aging oil magnate whose drilling sets off an ecological disaster. The supporting cast includes Riz Ahmed, John Goodman, Sandra Hüller, Michael Stuhlbarg, and Jesse Plemons. Iñárritu conceived the idea for Digger after working on The Revenant (2015). He wrote the screenplay with Sabina Berman, Alexander Dinelaris Jr., and Nicolás Giacobone, from a story by Iñárritu, Berman, and Jez Butterworth. Filming took place from November 2024 to May 2025 in the United Kingdom. Digger premiered in Leice
